name: Pedaiah
overview: Pedaiah appears in Scripture as a figure connected to significant lineages and roles in Israel's history. He is identified as the father of Zerubbabel and Joel, linking him to the royal line through his grandson King Josiah's mother, as well as to the tribe of Ephraim. Additionally, Pedaiah is noted as the son of Parosh and a Levite who served as treasurer under Nehemiah, highlighting his involvement in the post-exilic community's leadership. He is also mentioned as a Benjamite, illustrating the diversity of individuals bearing this name within Israel's tribes.
